glosses: iambic (consisting of iambs or characterized by their predominance)
Consisting of iambs (metrical feet with an unstressed-stressed pattern) or characterized by their predominance.

examples.text: [J]ust before the rhythm becomes iambic, there will be a point reached at which the rhythm can hardly be said to be more iambic than it is trochaic.

glosses: An iamb; a line or group of lines of iambs.
adj. [诗律]短长格的，抑扬格的
